fit.why: 4 of the 6 relevant reviews say the shoes run small and recommend going up a size, while only one says true to size, indicating a tendency to need a larger size.

quality.why: Star ratings range from 2 to 5 and comments focus on fit rather than durability, showing no clear consensus on overall quality.

look.styling_tip: Pair with leggings, shorts or joggers for running or casual sporty outfits.

what_would_settle_it: measure foot length in cm and compare to the size chart
